notes: This refutes the framing that ServerHost's USD 16.99 a year is a sub-USD-1-a-month machine. It is USD 1.42 a month, and the renewal price is not published, so even that figure is a first-term figure. RENEWAL PASS 2026-10-24: this is the clearest first-term promo. The discount arrives as a promo code on an annual billing cycle, and the same billing system publishes a monthly list price for the identical shape at 4.2x the promo's effective rate. Nothing read today says what year 2 costs, so the row stays paid-only and the renewal stays unpublished. Note the read caveat: the sale page came from a stored snapshot dated 2026-10-22, not a live fetch.
